musl 1.2.5 (https://musl.libc.org/), vendored for NovaOS
=======================================================

Source: the v1.2.5 release tag.  Only the math library and the C99
complex functions are kept (src/math and src/complex, with the headers
they include from src/internal and include, complex.h among them);
tools/build_userland.py compiles them into msvcrt.dll and ucrtbase.dll,
which export every public function (musl's internal helpers, whose names
start with "__", stay private).

include/bits/alltypes.h is a small NovaOS stand-in for the file musl's
build generates.
